stop_rule: Exactly the remaining +5/-5/+9 degree paired conditions, once each. Same pilot controller/coefficient/actor/model and original route/standing/motor gates. No automatic reruns, tuning or wider gates. Combined 10/10 plus both audits required before harder terrain.

report.name: slope+5-250us
report.navigation_localization: Exact simulator pose in an external navigator; actor receives its speed/yaw-rate command plus sensors.
limitations: Current detailed CAD; rigid tires, ideal gears, fixed slopes and nominal electrical/material priors.
Same actual-contact/hip-velocity standing gates as the terrain controller pilot.
Teacher labels use exact velocity and contacts. External navigation uses exact world pose; a student receives only the resulting command and its declared sensors.
This straight-driving cohort does not qualify turns, loose stones, recovery or hardware.
Outer stopping prediction is fitted from the old flat development run. Actor and native motor controller are frozen; this is not a new learned policy or hardware-localization validation.

stopping_preview.velocity_source: Backward difference of exact navigation wheel-midpoint X at 100 Hz; zero at initialization.
